limitations: Synthetic network, schedules, fares and riders only; GTFS and GTFS Realtime are format references, and no live feed is read.
Frequency-based schedules: trip instances are computed from frequencies with stable IDs; no stored timetable.
No global scheduler: time moves through events and Infra's env.advance_time, which runs no App code; time-based statuses are derived from the virtual time.
Subscriptions are evaluated only when a business event is applied, never on reads or clock movement.
The outbound Mail adapter is a standalone entry point invoked explicitly by the example and tests; without a caller, mail notifications stay pending_delivery.
